dogecoin.text:
The NFT depicting the original Doge meme, which was sold for around $4 million in June, is slated to be fractionalized into ERC-20 Tokens. This would allow every Dogecoin advocate to own a piece once it is auctioned off in $DOG.
https://t.co/Zd37Aq6Iz9

Elon Musk on Wednesday, diagnosed the problem with Dogecoin’s low commercial acceptance rate, as stemming from its unattractive fees, but it is unlikely any change can come sooner.
